sources.author: James C. Scott
sources.title: Seeing Like a State: How Certain Schemes to Improve the Human Condition Have Failed

sources.author: Albert O. Hirschman
sources.title: Exit, Voice, and Loyalty: Responses to Decline in Firms, Organizations, and States

sources.author: Elinor Ostrom
sources.title: Governing the Commons: The Evolution of Institutions for Collective Action

claims.claim: Statlig lesbarhet: Standarder, kart og kategorier gjør komplekse forhold administrativt lesbare.

source_evidence.locator: Part 1: State Projects of Legibility and Simplification, pp. 9–84

claims.claim: Høymodernistisk planlegging: Sterk teknisk styringsoptimisme kan bli farlig når lokal kunnskap og tilbakemelding fortrenges.

source_evidence.locator: Seeing Like a State, Chapter 3: Authoritarian High Modernism, pp. 88–94; administrative ordering, scientific/technical progress, rational design and state-backed social engineering with competing local judgment displaced

claims.claim: Praktisk lokalkunnskap: Situert erfaring kan inneholde informasjon standardiserte modeller overser.

source_evidence.locator: Chapter 9: Thin Simplifications and Practical Knowledge: Metis, p. 309

claims.claim: Exit: Misnøye kan møtes ved å forlate organisasjonen eller relasjonen.

source_evidence.locator: Hirschman 1980, Further Reflections, pp. 431–440; exit and voice as alternative recuperation mechanisms under organizational deterioration, including exit as leaving/switching and voice as attempts to influence or correct

claims.claim: Voice: Misnøye kan uttrykkes gjennom klage, protest, forhandling eller deltakelse.

source_evidence.locator: Hirschman 1980, pp. 431–438; voice complements or supersedes exit under decline, and conveys rich, detailed feedback through attempts to influence an organization when dissatisfied

claims.claim: Loyalty: Lojalitet kan forsinke exit og gi voice tid, men kan også dempe kritikk.

source_evidence.locator: Hirschman 1980, pp. 431 and 439–440, plus pp. 446–447; loyalty raises the cost of exit and stronger loyalty can shift dissatisfied members toward voice rather than exit

claims.claim: Fellesressurser: Vanskelig eksklusjon og rivaliserende bruk krever institusjonell analyse utover stat/marked-dikotomien.

source_evidence.locator: Ostrom 1999, Design Principles and Threats to Sustainable Organizations that Manage Commons, p. 1: CPR use is subtractable and exclusion is difficult

claims.claim: Institusjonelle designprinsipper: Langvarige ordninger viser gjentakende trekk i regler, overvåkning, sanksjoner og konfliktløsning.

source_evidence.locator: Ostrom 1999, pp. 1–6: seven design principles plus the eighth nested-enterprises principle for larger complex cases

claims.claim: Institusjonelt mangfold: Selvorganisering, offentlig regulering og marked kan kombineres på flere nivåer.

source_evidence.locator: Ostrom 2010, Beyond Markets and States, pp. 641–644: diverse private-for-profit, governmental and community arrangements operate at multiple scales; polycentric public/private production
